verdict.label: HOLD — No US session (Saturday); SPX 7,490 carry holds two-close reversal above 7,380; BTC ~$62,905 overnight above Gate 2 ($62,000) despite weekend low $62,260; PLTR earnings AH Monday August 3 and July NFP August 7 are the dual regime tests; 30Y 5.28%, September hike 82.4%, Brent ~$91, WTI ~$87 — 4 of 6 regime indicators breached entering the week
verdict.rationale_short: No US equity session today (Saturday). The two-close BEARISH regime reversal — formally confirmed at SPX 7,490 on July 31 — carries into Monday unchanged. BTC traded in a narrow band overnight, touching a low of $62,260 (approximately $260 above Gate 2 at $62,000) before recovering to ~$62,905 as of 01:08 UTC August 2, essentially flat from Friday's $62,929 close. The macro overhang is unchanged: 30Y yield at 5.28% (new 19-year high), September hike probability at 82.4% after Q2 ECI printed in-line at 0.9% QoQ on July 31 (the bond market treated in-line as insufficient relief, sending the 30Y up 16bps on the week), Brent above $91, and WTI above $87 leave 4 of 6 regime indicators breached. The two nearest catalysts that could materially change the read: PLTR Q2 earnings AH Monday August 3 (consensus $1.81B revenue +81% YoY, $0.35 EPS; options pricing ~15% swing) and July NFP Friday August 7. A PLTR miss combined with a hot NFP print would be the fastest path to invalidating the July 31 reversal by repressuring SPX below 7,380. AAPL ($309, structural miss) and AMD (~$430, rate compression) remain the two actively impaired names from Friday's session. AMZN +15% to $272 hit its August price target immediately on July 31; $290+ is the next level before NVDA August 26 earnings.

trade_setups.thesis: Q2 earnings the first major binary event of August. Consensus: $1.81B revenue (+81% YoY), $0.35 EPS. Options pricing ~15% swing (implied range $108-$146 from $127 carry). Three metrics determine the read: (1) AIP commercial ARR QoQ growth — need acceleration, not just continuation; (2) US commercial customer count — proxy for AIP land-and-expand velocity; (3) Government segment margins and DoD contract expansion — validates the post-July-30 IRGC-escalation urgency narrative. A clean beat + raised guidance = $140+ and a catalyst to sustain SPX above 7,380. A miss + soft guidance + September hike at 82.4% = $105-110 and the strongest fundamental stress test of the reversal to date.
trade_setups.entry: Watch AH print; $105-110 on a miss, $140+ on a strong beat with DoD contract expansion
trade_setups.invalidation: Revenue miss combined with soft government guidance and AIP ARR deceleration removes the DoD spending thesis

The two nearest stress tests: PLTR earnings AH Monday August 3 (event-driven selloff could gap futures) and July NFP Friday August 7 (above 150K print could push 30Y beyond 5.30% and reprice September hike above 90%). The read holds only if SPX does not close below 7,380.

trade_setups.thesis: July NFP is the most market-critical data point of the week. Context: FOMC held July 29 in a 9-3 dissent (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan voted for hike); September hike at 82.4% after Q2 ECI printed in-line July 31; 30Y already at 5.28% (19-year high). A print above 150K hardens September as near-certain, could push 30Y toward 5.40%, and risks SPX losing 7,380 on the same day. A print below 100K inverts the September probability and would be the first real macro catalyst for regime improvement. Prior consensus ~130-135K.
trade_setups.entry: Consider risk-reduction before the print if holding full equity exposure at 30Y above 5.28%
trade_setups.invalidation: Sub-100K print with cooling average hourly earnings clears the formal 30Y breach zone and begins unwinding September hike probability

trade_setups.thesis: 30Y at 5.28% (new 19-year high) moved +16bps on a week when ECI printed in-line at 0.9% — the move is policy-pricing-driven, not data-driven surprise. FOMC held with a 9-3 dissent July 29; September at 82.4%. The level that formally clears the breach: 30Y below 5.00% after a weak NFP print. Any extension above 5.30% during the week would add meaningful multiple compression to Nasdaq and further impair the AAPL/AMD complex.

trade_setups.invalidation: 30Y retreating below 5.00% after a sub-100K NFP print would clear the formal regime breach
trade_setups.horizon: Through August 7 NFP; August 13 CPI is second catalyst

bear_case: The July 31 reversal was earned on two sessions of tech earnings (MSFT + AMZN) — not on a macro turn. September hike at 82.4%, 30Y at 5.28% (new 19-year high), and Brent above $91 mean the macro regime has not flipped with the equity regime. If PLTR misses AH Monday August 3, the most direct path is an SPX pullback that tests 7,380 before NFP has even printed — a formal re-entry into BEARISH in Day 4 of a purported reversal. If July NFP then prints above 150K on August 7, September becomes near-certain, 30Y extends toward 5.40%, and SPX would re-enter formal BEARISH territory the same week it completed its reversal. BTC held overnight at $62,905 but the weekend low of $62,260 — approximately $260 above Gate 2 in thin Saturday volume — confirms that institutional sellers are standing close. A Monday open below $62,500 on PLTR earnings disappointment would put Gate 2 within a single session's reach. AAPL at $309 and AMD at $430 are still declining into a rate-headwind environment with no near-term catalysts. The reversal holds only if SPX stays above 7,380, BTC holds above $62,000 (UTC midnight basis), and July NFP does not print above 150K on August 7.
